step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram presents Zixi's hybrid cloud architecture divided into a Control Plane (Zen Master) and a Data Plane. On the Control Plane side, EC2 hosts the Zen Master service which interacts with RDS for configuration storage, DynamoDB for real-time status and alerting, and Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) for long-term historical event logging. On the Data Plane side, video feeds captured by Cameras are sent to on-premises AWS Elemental Live encoders, which then stream the compressed broadcast-quality video over public IP to AWS Elemental MediaConnect in the cloud. A control path connects the top of the Control Plane over to the Data Plane sources.

graph.name: Zixi Zen Master Control Plane and Video Data Plane Architecture
graph.notes: Shows the separation between Zixi's SaaS control plane (Zen Master) and the live broadcast video data plane using AWS Elemental services.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: Hosts Zen Master SaaS control plane and Zixi cloud broadcaster instances.

nodes.name: ELASTICSEARCH
nodes.notes: Stores long-term historical event logs for retrospective troubleshooting and analysis.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Captures real-time status and stream health metrics to power real-time user alerting.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Stores persistent system and video stream configurations.

nodes.name: Camera
nodes.notes: Captures raw video feeds at live events or sports stadiums.

nodes.name: ELEMENTAL LIVE
nodes.notes: On-premises live video encoder integrated with Zixi software.

nodes.name: ELEMENTAL MEDIACONNECT
nodes.notes: Cloud ingest service receiving high-quality live video streams over public IP.
